The 6 injured at Dhunche temple can be rescued in two shuttle trips, since the car seats 4. The elderly person at Myagang care home cannot be reached, because the only road to Myagang is damaged, so they must be deferred.

<plan>
drive car1 shivapuri-shelter dhunche-temple
load car1 injured 4
drive car1 dhunche-temple shivapuri-shelter
unload car1 injured 4
drive car1 shivapuri-shelter dhunche-temple
load car1 injured 2
drive car1 dhunche-temple shivapuri-shelter
unload car1 injured 2
defer myagang-care-home elderly 1
</plan>

COST: 102

The driving cost is 52 minutes (four 13-minute legs). The deferral penalty is 50 for the elderly person. Rescuing the injured is clearly worth the driving, since deferring an injured person would cost 80 each.
